messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 - Serving errors in us-west-2. Multiple pods OOMKilled + kubelet restarts on infer-usw2 nodes. Dashboard: https://redwood/incident/6262626262

leo: ack @incident-bot, I'm taking the pager. Starting triage.

jessica: seeing thermal/gpu driver failures then OOM cascade. Pasting recent kernel/container log snippet:
```
Mar 17 12:42:10 infer-node-11 kernel: NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00.0: GPU at risk - ECC error
Mar 17 12:42:12 infer-node-11 nvidia: nvidia: GPU driver panic, unloading
Mar 17 12:42:13 kubelet[1234]: NodeNotReady - heartbeat lost
Mar 17 12:42:16 containerd: oom killed serving-runtime pid=23456
```

leo: customer impact? metrics?

jessica: p95 latency jumped 80ms -> 2.3s, error-rate from 6% -> 18% over last 15m. Fallback routing engaged but ~12% L7 requests still 503.

support-sam: CS: two customers reported timeouts for chat completions, raising tickets.

leo: immediate actions: cordon affected nodes and drain safe pods, scale warm pool. Commands: 
```
kubectl cordon infer-node-11
kubectl drain infer-node-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force
kubectl scale deploy infer-warm-pool --replicas=6 -n inference
```

infra-bot: Runbook step applied: fallback routing -> 'stable-quantized' model variant for 30m. Policy active: route fallback when node_unavailable > 2.

mike: I'll take over pager in 10m. @leo please post node status.

leo: node snapshot:
```
infer-node-11 NotReady kubelet-restart x3 (last 3m)
infer-node-12 NotReady kubelet-restart x2 (last 2m)
infer-node-13 Ready but high GPU ECC counts
spare-usw-1 Ready
spare-usw-2 Ready
```

mike: plan: 1) evict noisy nodes 2) pin critical traffic to reserved pool 3) open HW ticket for GPU firmware/cooling. Escalate to hardware team if driver restarts fail.

jessica: applying temp memory footprint limits to avoid OOM cascade: patched serving-runtime config -> `max_request_buffer_mb: 64`, `kv_cache_memory_limit_mb: 240`. Monitoring.

leo: autoscaler at ~80% capacity. Initiating ASG scale +3 nodes in us-west-2.

infra-bot: ASG scale requested (+3). Estimated ready 6-9m.

mike: handoff accepted. @support-sam notify affected customers with ETA ~15m and workaround offer.

support-sam: sending notifications now with short blurb and ETA.

jessica: metrics improving: 503s -> 8%, p95 -> 420ms and trending down.

leo: kubelet crashloops correlate with driver unload after thermal event. Trying to avoid full reboot: `kubectl rollout restart ds/gpu-driver -n kube-system --field-selector spec.nodeName=infer-node-11` on suspects.

mike: if driver DS restart doesn't stabilize, cordon + terminate instance and let ASG reprovision. Keep me posted.

jessica: hardware note: fan speed alerts on infer-node-11. Created HW ticket HT-4621 (GPU thermal).

mike: update: we'll keep fallback routing for 30m, continue scaling spares. If stable for 20m and errors <2% we'll uncordon and move traffic back.

support-sam: customers notified; one asked for postmortem.

mike: acknowledged. We'll capture timeline and root cause after stabilization. Handoff to me as primary until resolved. :white_check_mark:
